stemMd: The statement “Only registered teams may compete” means which of the following?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Every team permitted to compete is registered.

explanationMd: “Only registered teams” makes registration a necessary condition for permission to compete. It does not force registered teams to participate or claim that all teams are registered. Distinguish a condition on eligibility from a duty to act.

distractorRationale.e: Permission and obligation differ, and registration need not guarantee entry under other rules.
distractorRationale.b: This is the opposite of the intended restriction.
distractorRationale.d: The statement restricts competitors, not all teams.
distractorRationale.c: No temporal order of that kind is stated.
